why: a line comment with no trailing newline runs to end of input
an unbalanced bracket inside a line comment must not be read as real code; the comment ends at (not including) the newline
a quote inside a line comment must not be read as a string delimiter
a simple block comment closes at its own */
an unbalanced brace inside a block comment must not be read as real code; the comment ends at its own closing */, not at the end of the whole source
an opening brace immediately inside a block comment must not bump nesting depth
